name: Template: Customer Success
description: Track account health from onboarding through expansion and renewal. Each swimlane represents a customer segment.

swimlanes.name: Americas
swimlanes.notes: US + Canada + LATAM accounts. CSM: Alex Rivera.

swimlanes.name: EMEA
swimlanes.notes: Europe, Middle East, Africa. CSM: Jordan Patel.

swimlanes.name: APAC
swimlanes.notes: Australia, Japan, SE Asia. CSM: Morgan Wu.

swimlanes.name: Enterprise Accounts
swimlanes.notes: 200+ seat strategic accounts managed directly by VP CS.

cards.title: Bright Solutions Inc — Onboarding
cards.description: New 150-seat account in onboarding phase. Strong champion in Taylor Chen (Head of Engineering). Technical team is eager to self-configure.

comments.body: Kickoff went great. Primary admin is Taylor Chen — very technical, will be self-sufficient quickly.
comments.author: demo1

activities.to_value: Kickoff went great. Primary admin is Taylor Chen — very technical, will be self-sufficient quickly.

cards.title: RocketOps LLC — Adoption
cards.description: 60-seat account in adoption. Board creation is good (12 boards) but only 30% of seats have been active in the last 30 days. QBR scheduled to review adoption blockers.

cards.title: Cirrus Analytics — Healthy
cards.description: 80-seat account in healthy state. VP Product (Jordan Lee) is an active champion and has recommended Visiban to two other companies in their portfolio.

cards.title: Vertex Media — Expansion
cards.description: 80-seat account is nearly at full capacity with 75 active users. Expansion to 150 seats in discussion. CFO meeting scheduled.

comments.body: They've grown from 40 to 75 active users. Seat expansion from 80 to 150 is the right next step.
comments.author: demo2

activities.to_value: They've grown from 40 to 75 active users. Seat expansion from 80 to 150 is the right next step.

cards.title: Polaris Engineering GmbH — Onboarding
cards.description: New 120-seat German engineering firm. GDPR DPA signed. SSO configured via Azure AD. First boards going live this week.

cards.title: Solaris Digital — Healthy
cards.description: 40-seat digital agency in healthy state. Self-sufficient — no CSM intervention needed. Utilization is strong at 85%.
